mapper.select: select ct.seq, ct.doctor_seq, ct.title, ct.contents, ct.interest, ct.image, ct.disease, ct.view_count, ct.priority, ct.is_viewed as viewed from cm_contents ct where disease_seq = #{disease} and is_enabled = True and is_viewed = True and EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(disease->'diseaseTreatment') treatment WHERE (treatment->>'seq')::int = #{diseaseTreatmentSeq} )
